name: Elai.io
summary: Elai.io enables users to produce professional AI videos from text with customizable digital avatars. Supports multiple languages and templates for e-learning, marketing, and training.
description:
Elai.io enables users to produce professional AI videos from text with customizable digital avatars. Supports multiple languages and templates for e-learning, marketing, and training.

AI avatar video creation: Turn any text into engaging videos with lifelike digital presenters, saving time and production costs. Multi-language support: Produce videos in over 65 languages, reaching diverse global audiences without additional translation work. Template library: Access a range of ready-made video templates for marketing, education, and business use cases. Bulk video generation: Generate hundreds of personalized videos simultaneously for campaigns, training, or customer outreach.

howToUse.title: Register and Log In
howToUse.description: Visit Elai.io and sign up for a free or premium account. Confirm your email and log into the dashboard.

howToUse.title: Create a New Video
howToUse.description: Click 'Create Video' and select a template or start with a blank project. Templates speed up the process for common use cases like marketing or training.

howToUse.title: Select an AI Avatar
howToUse.description: Choose from Elai's avatar library. Avatars can be filtered by language, appearance, and use case to match your audience.

howToUse.title: Enter or Upload Script
howToUse.description: Paste your script into each scene or upload a document. You can also use the AI script generator for content ideas or translation.

howToUse.title: Set Voice and Language
howToUse.description: Pick from dozens of AI voices and over 65 languages. Fine-tune speech speed, pitch, and accent for localization.

howToUse.title: Customize Scenes
howToUse.description: Edit backgrounds, change layouts, add images, logos, transitions, and arrange visual elements for each slide.

howToUse.title: Add Media and Effects
howToUse.description: Enhance scenes with video clips, stock images, animations, and audio. Adjust timing and animate elements for dynamic presentations.

howToUse.title: Preview & Edit
howToUse.description: Preview the video to check avatar performance, pronunciation, and scene flow. Make necessary edits before finalizing.

howToUse.title: Export or Share
howToUse.description: Export the video in your desired resolution (dependent on plan). Download or share via link or embed code.

howToUse.title: API & Automation (Advanced)
howToUse.description: For bulk or automated video generation, connect with Elai’s API. Use for CRM integration, mass personalization, or e-learning at scale.
